{{Top|leg}}
A '''shearing plane''' was a device capable of rendering [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] ineffective. The [[Sluissi]] [[Ten Dorne]] was working on a design for a shearing plane for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] before defecting to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
